title: $\widetilde{H}$-cobordisms, infinite cyclic covers, and real Seiberg--Witten theory
summary: We study $\widetilde{H}$-cobordisms of distinguished homology handles, introduced by Kawauchi in 1976 using infinite cyclic covers. Despite the extensive development of gauge-theoretic and Floer-theoretic invariants since Kawauchi's work, none were previously known to distinguish smooth and topological $\widetilde{H}$-cobordism. In this paper, we construct asymptotic invariants of distinguished homology handles by applying real Seiberg--Witten theory to finite cyclic covers.
